policy: SHRINK-ONLY build-visibility quarantine for scripts/check_layer_imports.py Rule 5. Lists .lean files under the enforced physics/Sprint12 dirs that are NOT compiled by CI's bare `lake build` (i.e. not reachable from a @[default_target] root) right now, each pinned to a tracking issue. The gate HARD-FAILS if: (1) a NEW build-invisible file appears that is not listed here (blocked immediately — a broken proof in it would ride CI-green); (2) a listed file becomes build-visible again (stale entry — remove it); (3) a listed file no longer exists (stale — remove it); (4) a listed file is not under an enforced dir; (5) any entry omits its tracking issue or reason. Adding an entry is a visible, reviewed commit that MUST name an open issue — never a silent CI baseline bump. The list can only lose entries.
